_about: Golden set for core/sr_levels.py (the chart's Support & Resistance indicator). Each case cuts the stored daily history at as_of and states the levels a careful reader of the bare candle chart marks, labelled from the candles before the module's output was looked at, then checked against the bars. 'must' = a level price reacted at two or more times (a double/triple top or bottom, a broken multi-touch floor), or a fresh extreme price is testing; 'should' = a single reaction or a judgment call. 'must' expectations fail tests.test_sr_levels; 'should' ones are reported as misses; a 'known' note marks a must the module does not yet draw, with the reason - reported every run, not failed, so the gate stays usable while the gap stays visible. A level passes when a KEY zone (what the chart draws by default) of an allowed role contains the price, within tol_atr x the chart timeframe's ATR of its edges; 'or_line' also accepts a drawn reference line there (a provisional 52-week extreme, say). 'no_key' forbids any key zone of that role; 'empty' forbids any key zone overlapping the range; 'line' requires a reference line of that kind.
